text:
sam: FYI we're seeing a steady rise in p99 on dedicated-usw1-s8. looks like a single tenant's workload is hammering both NIC and the kv-cache, causing regen storms. any quick wins?

lena: can you dump the hot-host metrics + alloc ids?

sam: sure - quick slice summary:
```
slice: dedicated-usw1-s8
hosts: rack-7-host2,rack-7-host3
allocs_by_tenant: {dataset-train: 42, mlprep: 18, inference-lite: 120}
gpu_util: 0.76
nic_tx_mbps (tail): 1300
kv_cache_miss_rate (mlprep): 0.33
request_latency_p99: 210ms
```

park: ugh. that kv_miss_rate is classic regen from prefetch + hot key churn. short path mitigation: flip the tenant prefetch to off and route new allocs through the alternate egress NIC on the host (proto: dataplane-proxy -> nic-b). that reduces KV churn and offloads the saturated TX queue.

lena: agree. we should avoid full cordon because there are dedicated commitments. soft-evict best-effort batch and do proxy route for lower-priority tenants. add a temporary nic-shaper if proxy path can't absorb all traffic.

oncall: taking action: 1) set tenant mlprep prefetch=off (applied), 2) evicted best-effort pods from s8 (batch jobs), 3) applied nic tx shaper 25% on rack-7-host2 at 2024-10-02T09:11Z. infra-bot will monitor.

infra-bot: action-log: prefetch_toggle tenant=mlprep -> off by @oncall; nic_shaper applied on rack-7-host2; evicted 14 best-effort pods; monitoring p99 and kv_miss_rate every 30s.

park: after the toggle, p99 dropped to ~115ms. kv_miss_rate trending down but still noisy. We should create a fingerprint rule so future allocs matching this behavior are routed to fractional dedicated slices and optionally billed a surcharge. Draft rule (yaml-like):

```
fingerprint_rule:
  name: kv-nic-tail-fingerprint
  condition:
    kv_miss_rate: 
      gt: 0.2
      window: 5m
    nic_tx_mbps_tail:
      gt: 1000
      window: 5m
  actions:
    - assign: fractional_dedicated
    - tenant_config:
        prefetch: off
    - tag: noisy-tenant
    - billing: flag_for_review
  rollout: canary(10%, region=us-west1)
```

lena: solid. two notes: (1) need a simulation job to estimate extra reserved capacity cost before we enable billing flags, (2) for infra telemetry, add a `fingerprint_count` metric so we can track recurrence.

sam: i'll run a 48h sim across top-10 noisy tenants and post numbers. want to include model of fractional slice fill-rate and extra monthly reserved delta.

oncall: i'll own the canary deploy once sim looks OK. suggest a 10% rollout to us-west1 for 24h. if p99 improvement >20% and no regression in cold-start rate, we promote.

lena: filing follow-ups: 1) sim (sam), 2) add prefetch toggle endpoint (park), 3) add fingerprint_count telemetry (infra-bot), 4) finance check on reserve-cost delta (tag: @finance). I'll open a quick thread in #product later for SLA language. :thumbsup:
